# Input для video-prompt — animate a still for Kling

## Brief

Image-to-video для Reels: 5-7 секунд клипа из готового still кадра.

## Still description

Кадр: woman in her thirties sitting at a cafe window table, reading a book, golden hour backlight. Holding a ceramic mug. Soft focus on background (busy street).

## Goal

Cinematic motion — slow build of intimacy.

## Constraints

- Target model: Kling 3.0
- Duration: 6 seconds
- Pacing: narrative (breathing beat — not action)
- Camera move: slow dolly push-in toward her face
- Required: CHARACTER FIRST law, Beat 1/2/3 structure, Kling temporal markers «First [0-Xs]: ...»
- Forbidden: "she smiles" (single gesture → frozen); "subtle movement" (vague)

## Expected output

5-8 sentence motion prompt with body-part-specific repeated actions across 3 beats + 1 camera sentence at the end.
